messages.author: 7c6391cd5b91cf39
messages.subject: Using NIMBLE on R server
parts:
Hey everyone, 

I am having some problems trying to install NIMBLE on my University's server. When I download the package I get the following error message:

In file included from bliss.cc:20:
bliss/graph.hh:326: error: ISO C++ forbids initialization of member ‘refine_equal_to_first’
bliss/graph.hh:326: error: making ‘refine_equal_to_first’ static
bliss/graph.hh:326: error: ISO C++ forbids in-class initialization of non-const static member ‘refine_equal_to_first’
make: *** [bliss.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘igraph’
* removing ‘/home/ecg/fk231/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.5/igraph’
Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘igraph’ had non-zero exit status
ERROR: dependency ‘igraph’ is not available for package ‘nimble’
* removing ‘/home/ecg/fk231/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.5/nimble’
Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘nimble’ had non-zero exit status

When I also try to download the igraph package, I get the same type of error saying igraph had non-zero exit status. Any ideas what I can do to get NIMBLE installed? I think it may be a compilation issue but the server has GNU C++.  It should also be noted that the Rstudio on the server is really outdated (3.5.2 (2018-12-20)).  Any help is much appreciated.

Kind regards,
Fabian

messages.author: bebd85531a67ef86
messages.subject: Re: Using NIMBLE on R server
parts:
Hi Fabien

Without seeing the error message from the igraph installation we can only guess. 

But assuming that you have tried (and failled) to install all dependancies...

... it could be a permissions issue. In which case you could try two things.  

1) try to install the dependant packages to a directory to which you have permission to write to. i.e. "~/R" (if "cd ~/" takes you to your personal directory on the server). 
2) contact the administrator and ask them to help with any dependencies you cannot install using the above method.

If this is not a permissions issue... Sometimes these sorts of problems can be solved by installing older versions available in the CRAN archieves. This can get you out of a mess if a certain dependancy cannot be met because a new version of some package is not yet available for the operating system you are using.

Good luck
David

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Using NIMBLE on R server
parts:
So the igraph installation is failing. This is unrelated to nimble, but igraph does need to be installed for nimble to be installed.

I suspect you have an old version of gcc.  You could check with the administrator of your server if a newer version is available (or could be made available) on the system and use that.
Alternatively, as discussed here, you could install an old version of igraph and then install nimble.

Chris
